- Temp-to-perm opportunity
- Opportunity to develop within a busy operational environment
- Supportive team environment

Interested?

title: Operations Coordinator
company: Pertemps Black Country Perms - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day operational activities of the business. The role will be responsible for coordinating sales administration, stock control, export documentation, logistics management, ERP system administration, and customer service activities to ensure smooth and efficient business operations. The successful candidate will work closely with internal departments, suppliers, warehouses, freight providers, and customers to maintain high service levels and operational excellence.
Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate daily operational activities to ensure efficient order processing and fulfilment.
- Process customer orders accurately and efficiently through ERP systems.
- Generate quotations, sales orders, invoices, credit notes, and other customer documentation.
- Monitor stock levels and maintain accurate inventory records within ERP systems.
- Track inventory movements, stock adjustments, and replenishment requirements.
- Liaise with warehouse teams to investigate stock discrepancies and implement corrective actions.
- Produce stock reports and forecasts to support planning and procurement activities.
- Monitor product shelf life and minimise risks associated with aged or obsolete stock.
- Support ERP system improvements, testing, and implementation projects.
- Prepare export documentation including commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates, and customs paperwork.
- Ensure compliance with export regulations, customs requirements, and international trading standards.
- Coordinate domestic and international shipments with freight forwarders, hauliers, and logistics partners.
- Track shipments and provide customers with delivery updates.
- Work closely with warehouse teams to ensure accurate and timely dispatch of goods.
- Deliver exceptional customer service by handling enquiries, complaints, and order-related issues.
- Build strong relationships with customers, suppliers, logistics providers, and internal stakeholders.
- Support with reporting and process improvements

Key Skills
- Previous experience in an Operations Coordinator, Sales Administrator, Customer Service, Logistics, Export, or Supply Chain role.
- Strong knowledge of stock control and inventory management processes.
- Experience using ERP systems for order processing and inventory management.
- Knowledge of export documentation and international shipping procedures.
- Excellent administrative and organisational skills.
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including reporting and data analysis.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

If you have a background in international operations, stock control, ERP systems, sales support, export or logistics coordination this could be the role for you.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Job Title: Customer Service Advisor

Location: Halesowen (B62)

Salary: £26,938 - £28,609 per annum + up to £2000 Performance related bonus

Job Type: Full Time, Permanent

Working Hours: 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday between 08:30am to 18:30pm on a 5-week rotational shift pattern. 1 in 3 Saturdays 09:00am - 17:30pm.
- Early Shift: 8:30am - 17:00pm
- Mid Shift: 9:00am - 17:30pm
- Late Shift: 10:00am - 18:30pm

As a Customer Service Advisor, you will provide a professional first point of contact for customers, colleagues and external business partners in order to ensure the delivery of an exceptional customer experience.

What you will be doing:
- Serve our customers regardless of the channel they use, e.g. web, telephone, email, etc.
- Use My Policy systems to enter customer data to a high standard of accuracy.
- Validate and process new customer accounts assisting customers with any account related enquiries.
- Maintain a strong and up to date working knowledge of all processes relating to relevant products and services.
- To work collaboratively with your peer group and other colleagues sharing best practice.
- When appropriate, seeks opportunities to add value to the customer and build customer loyalty through the promotion of My Policy products and services.
- Provide administrative support to ensure activities related to customer's accounts are carried out in a timely manner and records are maintained.
- Establish and communicate high standards of customer service in line with the company's values and culture.
- Establish and communicate high standards of customer service in line with the company's values and culture.
- Identify and escalate to your line manager any key customer impacting issues to achieve greater business wide success.
- Maintain effective working practices in a team environment, ensuring that compliance and service delivery standards are in line with quality and compliance framework and regulatory requirements.
- Contribute to an open and honest culture within teams through collaborative and supportive working.
- Support a culture of continuous improvement for Customer experience, and operating systems.
- Liaise with relevant stakeholders across the business to instigate and influence positive change.

What we're looking for:
- Strong Communicator
- Effective decision maker in a fast-paced environment
- Individuals who have a passion and commitment to providing quality Customer Service
- Team Player
- Able to prioritise workloads to meet challenging deadlines and ability to multi-task and self-organise.
- Pro-active and well organised
- Adaptable
- Computer literate and proficient in MS Office suite

- A desire to develop own skill sets

Candidates with experience or relevant job titles of; Customer Services Administrator, Customer Service Representative, Customer Support, Client Service, Sales Support, Customer Service Consultant, Customer Service Administrator, Business Support, Office Administrator and Administrative will all be considered.
